name: tsn5g-ue-web
description: Marker file, not a dependency manifest. There are no dependencies, no build step and no node_modules. Browsers decide module-vs-script from the MIME type and the <script type="module"> tag, but Node decides from this field — so without it, `node --check` and the unit checks in scripts/ treat every .js file as CommonJS and reject `import`. Node is used here as a parser and test runner only.
